citizenDash.greeting: Muraho {{name}} — genzura mbere yo gusangiza abandi.
citizenDash.subtitle: Komeka umuyoboro, ubone igisubizo mu masegonda makeya.

quickAnalyze.title: Ese ni ukuri?
quickAnalyze.subtitle: Komeka umuyoboro cyangwa igice cy'inkuru. Tuzayinyuza muri modeli eshatu mu masegonda makeya.

trust.label: Amanota yawe y'ikizere
trust.copyNone: Kora isesengura ryawe rya mbere kugira ngo ubone amanota yawe bwite y'ikizere.
trust.copyHigh: Ibyinshi mu byo ugenzura biba ari iby'ukuri. Komeza kugenzura mbere yo gusangiza abandi.
trust.copyMixed: Ibimenyetso bivanze — komeza kwitonda mbere yo gusangiza abandi ibyo usoma.
trust.copyLow: Ufata ibintu byinshi bishidikanywaho. Ubwo bwitonzi burinda buri wese ukukikije.

recent.heading: Amagenzura yawe aheruka
recent.subtitle: Impamvu zigaragazwa ni ikimenyetso cya mbere cy'ingenzi modeli yagaragaje kuri buri kintu.
recent.emptyBody: Komeka umuyoboro mu kazu kari hejuru kugira ngo ukore igenzura ryawe rya mbere.

emotionalHeadlines.title: Itonde imitwe y'inkuru ikangura amarangamutima
emotionalHeadlines.body: Imitwe y'inkuru ikabya cyangwa itera ubwoba ni ikimenyetso gisanzwe cy'ibintu bidafite ikizere. Hagarara mbere yo gusangiza abandi.

checkSource.title: Genzura inkomoko
checkSource.body: Amazina ya domaine atazwi, URL zigana izindi, n'amazina y'abanditsi abura ni ibimenyetso bibi. Shakisha izina ry'urubuga ku giti cyaryo.

crossReference.title: Gereranya inkuru n'ahandi
crossReference.body: Amakuru y'ukuri akunze gutangazwa n'urubuga rumwe gusa gake. Niba nta yindi nkomoko ifite ikizere iyivuga, uyifate ushidikanya.

readPastHeadline.title: Soma urenze umutwe w'inkuru
readPastHeadline.body: Inkuru nyinshi ziyobya zifite imitwe itahuje n'ibikubiyemo nyabyo. Soma inkuru yose mbere yo kugira icyo utekereza.

reverseImage.title: Shakisha amafoto mu buryo buhindukira
reverseImage.body: Amafoto akunze gukoreshwa nta gihe kibereye. Ishakisha ryihuse rishobora kwerekana itariki n'inkomoko by'umwimerere.

checkDate.title: Genzura itariki
checkDate.body: Inkuru za kera zikunze kongera kugaruka nk'aho ari nshya. Buri gihe genzura itariki yo gutangaza mbere yo kubyitabira.

perfectQuotes.title: Witondere amagambo meza cyane
perfectQuotes.body: Inkuru zihimbano zikunze kuba zikubiyemo amagambo y'abantu bazwi yatunganyijwe cyane adashobora kugenzurwa ahandi.
